scope: ONLY one replacement racer sound cue; no app/art/other scene changes
format: PCM16 mono48k app, float32 mono48k master

timeline.action: Helmet appears; low engine wakes up.
Accelerate and move Buddy+helmet together away/offscreen.
Return pass, engine grows and slows.
One bounded stylised tyre screech while braking back to centre.
Settle; costume clears and exact plain Buddy returns.

playback: One finite source at racer scene0, replacing old racer_soft_wind. Do NOT layer old wind, duplicate screeches, loop or retrigger from sensor/touch. Preserve immediate mute, hidden/pagehide cleanup, fixed scene lock and seven-second deadline. Reduced motion keeps helmet static/crossfades with same single sound cue if unmuted.
mouth_occlusion: Code should hide/occlude live mouth ONLY when costume region physically covers it (e.g.racing full helmet), not globally alter Buddy or hide mouth on open-face costumes. Parent helmet/mask and face under same scene motion.
provenance: Original deterministic additive engine and band-limited synthetic tyre sound created by this source. No recordings/samples/voices/brands/copied themes/external downloads.
